sentences.en: After all, even salesmen are desperate to avoid being targeted for downsizing.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，即使是推销员也迫切希望避免被列为裁员对象。

sentences.en: The company I worked for was downsizing. Unfortunately, I lost my job.
sentences.zh: 我工作的公司正在裁员。不幸的是，我也丢了工作。

sentences.en: Corporations are downsizing and reducing the amount of profits they put back into R&D.
sentences.zh: 企业正在裁员，并且减少了投入到研发中的利润比例。

senses.zh: 以较小尺寸设计（或制造），缩小（汽车等的）外部尺寸
